environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Node.js 18.x) deployed via SAM template, running in default VPC with standard Lambda networking. Function has IAM role with ec2:DescribeInstances and s3:GetObject permissions. The function is invoked via API Gateway HTTP API with no additional request validation. Lambda runtime has unrestricted outbound network access to all IP ranges including the instance metadata service at 169.254.169.254. IMDSv1 is available (no hop limit enforcement at the network level for Lambda).
